title: pTron Studio w/ 60Hrs Playtime, Wireless Over-Ear Headphones with HD Mic, Dual-Device Pairing, Immersive Sound, 40mm Drivers, BT5.4, 3.5mm Aux Port, TF Card Slot & Type-C Fast Charging (Jet Black)
bullets: Enjoy all-day comfort with pTron Studio Over-Ear Bluetooth Wireless Headphones featuring soft earpads, ergonomic design, built-in mic, and adjustable headband for the perfect fit and effortless use.
Enjoy 60 Hours of playtime on a single charge with 40mm drivers for rich stereo sound. Built-in HD mic ensures clear calls. Fast 2.5 Hours recharge via Type-C (DC5V-1A max.) keeps you powered longer.
Bluetooth v5.4 Headphones with Instant Pairing, 10m Stable Range & Wide Device Compatibility || Enjoy Seamless Dual-device Pairing to Connect & Switch between Phone, Tablet, or Laptop with Ease
Enjoy Playback via Bluetooth or 3.5mm Aux-in Port, or Use a TF Card || IPX4 Water-Resistant headphones designed to Withstand Sweat and Spills with Ease for Worry-free Listening
Foldable Design for Easy Storage || Easy Controls - Manage Music & Calls with Multi-functional Buttons || 6 Months Manufacturer Warranty from the Date of Purchase on Manufacturing Defects Only
